description: This file contains the final class UriResolver which provides static methods for resolving and relativizing URIs, including handling dot segments according to RFC 3986.

classes.name: UriResolver
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to resolve and relativize URIs based on RFC 3986, handling relative URIs with respect to a base URI.

methods.name: removeDotSegments
methods.description: Removes dot segments ('..', '.') from a path to produce a normalized path string.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a relative URI against a base URI to produce a new absolute URI.

methods.name: relativize
methods.description: Produces a relative URI from a base URI to a target URI.

methods.name: getRelativePath
methods.description: Helper method to compute a relative path from base to target URI.
